Promoted 2026-08-03 (pjm-151). ONE measured delta separates this keeper from the superseded 2026-08-03-pjm-147b-chp-heat: pjm_seam_envelope_by_neighbor, a rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] INTERNAL-CONSISTENCY REPAIR that closes root-cause item 12 (carried since pjm-135). It adds ZERO free parameters and the DOF ledger is carried VERBATIM (n_entries 19, n_residual 6, asserted by scripts/gen_pjm151_attestation.py rather than claimed in prose).

THE DEFECT. envelopes._PJM_TIE_ZONE put the WHOLE TVA tie on PJM_Dominion while INTERFACE_NEIGHBORS' TVA interface spans PJM_AEP_Ohio + PJM_Dominion (LGEE is inconsistent the SAME way -- it is not the self-consistent contrast case earlier handoffs described). The two structures are not independent: inject_pjm_seam_flow_limit built a per-ZONE p90 envelope from the first and SUMMED it over the second, and a zone bucket holds every tie that lands in it, so each seam's cap absorbed other seams' ties.

THE FIX, AND WHY NO SHARE NEEDED DERIVING. The charter was to derive the TVA two-zone split from a measured basis or stop. The split is the WRONG QUESTION for the mechanism that matters: the object the cap needs is per-NEIGHBOUR, and the per-zone envelope is an intermediary whose own source calls it 'Tier 3 (calibration) -- approximate'. Building each seam's envelope from its OWN ties needs only spec.PJM_TIE_NEIGHBOR, an IDENTITY read off PJM's own tie labels. Zero free parameters (rule 5); same measured file at the same shipped p90, so rule 13 is unchanged. _PJM_TIE_ZONE is NOT changed and is NOT wrong -- it stays the right grain for the genuinely per-zone objects (the zonal net-position schedule feeding load_demand, and the star topology's per-border link caps).

MEASURED EX ANTE, NO LP (scripts/probes/pjm151_seam_envelope_attribution.py). Legacy cap / direct cap: TVA export 124x/53x/40x, LGEE export 33x/42x/26x, neither binding in ANY 2023-24 (month x hod) cell -- so pjm_seam_export_limit, armed on the incumbent PRECISELY to fix the structural over-export, was effectively INERT on two of the five seams. It LOOSENS as well as tightens: the legacy LGEE IMPORT cap is 0 MW against a measured p90 of 518/539/549 MW, and the legacy Carolinas EXPORT cap is 0.67/0.97/0.81x measured. NYISO reproduces at ratio 1.00 exactly (its border zone holds only its own four ties) -- the control the measurement carries.

RESULT. Arm is LIVE (max |dMW| on the P1 class-hour 1481.3/1699.2/1647.6). NO criterion regresses: all eight model-determined criteria identical to the incumbent, C1 'all 16/16 - free 12/12' unchanged, CALIBRATED 9/9 zero caveats. The pre-registered E1 C1-magnitude gate passes with ZERO breaches -- largest class move 1.24 TWh against a declared 3.0 TWh cap. GAS improves in all three years (+4.98/+10.92/+23.05 -> +3.91/+9.34/+21.02 TWh); COAL degrades slightly (-8.01/-7.79/-2.61 -> -8.37/-8.22/-3.14).

THE TRADE, PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE SOLVING AND STATED NOT ABSORBED. Net export falls in all three years, so the INTERCHANGE family error goes -10.82/-9.86/+8.20 -> -12.48/-12.22/+5.21 TWh: BETTER in 2025 (the over-export year) and WORSE in 2023-24 (the under-export years). PREREG-pjm151 §6 declared this direction before the arm solved, so it is a confirmed expectation, not a discovered surprise. Per rules 1 and 14 the consistent attribution ships regardless of the residual; the 2023-24 under-export is recorded as OPEN root-cause item 15, NOT as a reason to restore the inconsistency or tune the tie map.

RULE 26 [R-DELETE] FOLLOW-UP, OWED: the flag is gated only to keep this A/B single-delta on an ISO with zero caveat budget. With it promoted, collapsing pjm_seam_envelope_by_neighbor and DELETING the zone-summed path is owed -- a repaired mechanism must not leave a re-armable broken version parsing. note: Open ROOT CAUSES. (1) THE ZONAL-CONGESTION ROUTE TO THE DOMINION CT LEG IS CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT (pjm-137). Always take a zonal class actual from frontend/data/backcast/bench/<ISO>/<year>.json.gz, which carries split: 'unit_hourly' at mixed sites. (3) THE SUCCESSOR'S TARGET, RESTATED ON THE CORRECTED HOUR KEY (pjm-138 A1 + pjm-139). The Dominion CT-hour price deficit is $17.97/$26.44/$54.06 per MWh, NOT the $17.72/$26.69/$54.61 this note carried: pjm-137's measured-side loader indexed Eastern PREVAILING time against a model and a CAMPD record that are BOTH Eastern STANDARD, so from March to November its series sat one hour ahead of both. AND THE REACHABLE SHARE IS CONCENTRATED, NOT SPREAD ACROSS CT HOURS (pjm-139): it lives in the WINTER MORNING RAMP. DJF h06-h07 CT-weighted the residual after both closed lanes is $3.93/$30.48/$40.11 (load-weighted after the reserve credit -$0.37/+$5.55/+$13.44, so 2023 is fully explained and 2024-25 are not), while DJF midday and overnight run NEGATIVE -- the model is too DEAR there. The defect is a RAMP-RATE deficit, not a level or a fuel-price one: PJM's own DJF system energy price rises +$15.28/+$21.63/+$35.45 from h04 to h07 and the model's rises +$3.93/+$4.55/+$6.51, 26/21/18 % of it, and the model's whole-day DJF trough-to-peak range is 32/27/21 % of PJM's. Root cause measured: the keeper runs ramp_limits=False, so the LP has NO intertemporal thermal coupling and meets the winter morning ramp with STEAM it ramps 1.8/2.4/2.6x harder than the real fleet instead of the CTs PJM actually starts (model CT rise only 58/76/83 % of actual) -- which also predicts the standing CT_PEAKER -2.11/-3.57/-3.32 TWh C1 note. THE CHARTERED SUCCESSOR LEVER IS NOW SPENT AND THE DEFECT IS STILL OPEN (pjm-140). ramp_envelopes was armed, A/B tested across all three years and PROMOTED -- it is matrix PJM K and lives in this keeper -- but it moves the DJF h04->h07 rise only +$0.07/+$0.05/+$0.03 (0.6/0.2/0.1 % of the remaining gap), so the winter morning ramp's ROOT CAUSE REMAINS UNIDENTIFIED. See FINDING-pjm140-ramp-envelopes-remove-infeasible-ramping-but-not-the-price-shape-2026-07-30.md and FINDING-pjm139-winter-morning-ramp-is-a-ramp-rate-deficit-2026-07-30.md.
